negative.why_it_is_the_whole_discriminator: a fork detector that fires on everything that merely LOOKS alike passes all five positive arms and is worthless. The negative control is a criterion in its own right at the cut, not a clause inside the fork criterion -- a compound clause would let a detector pass on 'found the forks' while also returning this pair.
